property_summary: Rule: Only the contract owner can call owned() successfully (i.e., calls to owned() succeed when and only when msg.sender == owner); the mutant inverts the check allowing non-owners to call owned(), so there exist callers for which the behavior (call success) differs.
change_summary: Invert the owner check in onlyOwner to require msg.sender != owner, allowing only non-owners to pass the modifier and thus changing who can call owned().
